name: 43147 · Pickerington, OH
findings: ZIP 43147 (Pickerington) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43147 (Pickerington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
